nodes.name: Is Photo?
nodes.notes: نوع الرسالة ايه؟ صوره ولا تكست؟

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ...$json, prompt: 'A customer wrote to an Egyptian pharmacy. Return JSON only: {"is_prescription": false, "readable": true, "medicines": [{"name": "", "strength": "", "qty": 1}], "other": "greeting|question|empty"}. Only medicines the customer asks for. Message: <<<' + $json.text + '>>>' } }];

const buf = await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0, 'data');
return [{ json: { ...$('Normalize Message').first().json, b64: buf.toString('base64'), mime: $input.first().binary.data.mimeType || 'image/jpeg', prompt: 'This is a photo of an Egyptian prescription or medicine box. Return JSON only: {"is_prescription": true|false, "readable": true|false, "medicines": [{"name": "", "strength": "", "qty": 1}]}. qty = boxes requested, default 1. Never guess an unreadable name: put it as "?".' } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.prompt }].concat($json.b64 ? [{ inline_data: { mime_type: $json.mime, data: $json.b64 } }] : []) }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.1 } }) }}

parameters.text: ={{ '⚠️ Could not read a request from ' + $('Normalize Message').first().json.customer_id + ': ' + ($('Normalize Message').first().json.text || '[photo]') + '. Please reply to the customer directly.' }}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Apply Decision').first().json;
return d.lines.map(l => ({ json: { res_id: l.res_id, status: d.action === 'approve' ? 'reserved' : 'rejected', expires_at: d.action === 'approve' ? d.exp : '', pharmacist: d.by } }));
